# Reference Notes 

Made By Abhik Biswas 

**The Rule of the Exchange Operator** _P_<sup>ˆ</sup> 12 

The permutation operator _P_<sup>ˆ</sup> 12 simply **swaps the particle labels (** 1 _↔_ 2 **)** : 

- _P_<sup>ˆ</sup> 12 _| ↑_ 1 _↓_ 2 _⟩_ = _| ↑_ 2 _↓_ 1 _⟩_ = _| ↓_ 1 _↑_ 2 _⟩ (Particle 1 gets down-spin, Particle 2 gets up-spin)_ 

- • _P_<sup>ˆ</sup> 12 _| ↓_ 1 _↑_ 2 _⟩_ = _| ↓_ 2 _↑_ 1 _⟩_ = _| ↑_ 1 _↓_ 2 _⟩ (Particle 1 gets up-spin, Particle 2 gets down-spin)_ 

**1. How Singlet state turns into** _−χ_ **singlet** 

Given the Singlet state: 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
χ singlet = 1<br>√ 2 ( | ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩−| ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩ )<br><!-- End of picture text -->

1. **Apply** _P_<sup>ˆ</sup> 12 **to each state inside:** 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
P ˆ12 χ singlet = √ 1 2 ( P ˆ12 | ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩− P ˆ12 | ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩ )<br><!-- End of picture text -->

2. **Swap the particle positions:** 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
P ˆ12 χ singlet = 1<br>√ 2 ( | ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩−| ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩ )<br><!-- End of picture text -->

3. **Factor out a minus sign (** _−_ 1 **):** 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
1<br>( | ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩−| ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩ ) =  −χ singlet<br>√ 2 ( | ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩−| ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩ ) =  − √ 1 2<br><!-- End of picture text -->

**Key Reason:** Because of the **minus sign (** _−_ **)** between the two terms, swapping them reverses their subtraction order: ( _A − B_ ) _→_ ( _B − A_ ) = _−_ ( _A − B_ ). 

**2. How Triplet state turns into** + _χ_ **triplet** Given the Triplet state ( _MS_ = 0): 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
χ triplet = 1<br>√ 2 ( | ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩ +  | ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩ )<br><!-- End of picture text -->

1. **Apply** _P_<sup>ˆ</sup> 12 **to each state inside:** 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
P ˆ12 χ triplet = √ 1 2 ( P ˆ12 | ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩ + P ˆ12 | ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩ )<br><!-- End of picture text -->

2. **Swap the particle positions:** 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
P ˆ12 χ triplet = 1<br>√ 2 ( | ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩ +  | ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩ )<br><!-- End of picture text -->

3. **Rearrange addition terms (** _A_ + _B_ = _B_ + _A_ **):** 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
1<br>( | ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩ +  | ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩ ) = + χ triplet<br>√ 2 ( | ↓ 1 ↑ 2 ⟩ +  | ↑ 1 ↓ 2 ⟩ ) = + √ 1 2<br><!-- End of picture text -->

**Key Reason:** Because of the **plus sign (** + **)** between the two terms, addition is commutative: ( _A_ + _B_ ) _→_ ( _B_ + _A_ ) = +( _A_ + _B_ ). 

## **In Summary** 

- **Minus sign in Singlet:** Swapping terms flips the sign _→_ **Antisymmetric (Eigenvalue =** _−_ 1 **)** . 

- **Plus sign in Triplet:** Swapping terms leaves the sign unchanged _→_ **Symmetric (Eigenvalue =** +1 **)** .
